messages.author: yunshi11
messages.body:
Hi all,
I am trying to compare traj1.nc vs traj2.nc. They have the same topology in
xyz.prmtop.
Using rms2d, how to generate a 2d rms comparison?
I tried the following in cpptraj but it gave me a comparison of traj1.nc vs
traj1.nc instead:
parm xyz.prmtop
loadcrd traj2.nc
trajin traj1.nc
rms2d .CA out test2drms.gnu reftraj traj1.nc
Thanks,
Yun

messages.author: Dr. Anselm Horn
messages.body:
Yun,
the description of rms2d in the manual (AmberTools23 p. 830) would
suggest something like:
parm xyz.prmtop
trajin traj1.nc
rms2d .CA out test2drms.gnu reftraj traj2.nc
Does this work?
Best,
Anselm
PD Dr.rer.nat.
Bioinformatik  |  NHR.FAU
Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU)
Germany
